findings.title: Env value refers to a variable not defined before it
findings.cause: container worker's env API_URL refers to $(API_HOST), which is defined after API_URL in the env list: the kubelet expands a reference only from variables defined before it, so API_URL holds the text $(API_HOST) unexpanded and the process fails on it; its log says: "wget: bad address '$(API_HOST):8080'"; Deployment worker has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container worker exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 5 times
last lines of container worker's log (current run)
container worker's env, in order: API_URL is entry 1 and refers to $(API_HOST)
evidence.command: kubectl get pod worker-86bfdfc864-8snpf -n kd-env-var-defined-later -o jsonpath='{range .spec.containers[?(@.name=="worker")].env[*]}{.name}={.value}{"\n"}{end}'

findings.fix: Move API_HOST above API_URL in the container's env list: a value can refer only to variables defined before it.
